description: "The Song of Hiawatha" by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow is an epic poem published in 1855.
longDescription: Set along Lake Superior's shores, it follows the fictional adventures of Ojibwe warrior Hiawatha and his tragic love for Minnehaha, a Dakota woman.

authorInfo.bio: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow (1807–1882) wrote The Song of Hiawatha: An Epic Poem. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
